observations: Blue painted industrial gearbox with a flanged input and output shaft.
A black label is affixed to the side of the housing, but the text is illegible in the photo.
The output shaft appears to be made of steel.
The unit is resting on a dirt surface.
A watermark 'CHIDONBEST INDUSTRIAL' is visible across the image.

claims.evidence: The motor is not visible in the photo; only the gearbox is shown.
No horsepower rating is legible on the label in photo 0.
No gear ratio is legible on the label in photo 0.

risks.risk: The gearbox may be seized or have internal damage.
risks.proof: A video showing the gearbox being operated or a photo of the output shaft rotating.

risks.risk: The motor may be missing or non-functional.
risks.proof: A photo of the motor and a video of it running.

risks.risk: The horsepower and gear ratio may be inaccurate.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the label on the gearbox housing.

proof_requests: Close-up of the label on the gearbox to read the brand, model, and specifications.
Photo of the motor if it is included.
Video of the gearbox being operated to confirm it is not seized.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
